pitches.logline: A man doing his mother's Saturday shopping at the huge Lilo market lot: his paper bag rips, the oranges roll, and he cannot find his car among endless rows while mom keeps calling.
pitches.hook: the bag rips by the stalls, oranges roll across the asphalt (paper tear)

pitches.logline: A taxi driver at the Tbilisi train station rank leaves the car to help a passenger with luggage and loses it among the identical white cabs.
pitches.hook: a passenger yells 'which one is yours?' over a horn

pitches.logline: A dad at the Batumi seaside in August, kids sandy and crying, cannot remember which beach car park street the car is on.
pitches.hook: a child screams and drops an ice cream on the hot pavement

treatment.logline: A man at the Lilo market on a Saturday: the bag rips, the car is lost in a sea of parked cars and mom calls him a fool; next time one tap saves the spot and he walks straight to it.
treatment.hero: me: a man in a bomber jacket and buzz cut, doing mom's shopping; his car is the accent-coloured crossover
treatment.obstacle: the Lilo lot is endless rows of the same cars, his hands are full and he never noted where he left it

hook.event: the paper bag rips by the market stalls, the oranges roll away across the asphalt

act1: the bag rips and the oranges roll
the rows of parked cars never end: which one is mine
mom calls: 'you fool, where are you?'
treatment.turn: a half-second hold after mom's line, then the app

reveal.what: the app's real home, pushed in on the 'where the car stands' row

screens.step: scroll, tap the 'where the car stands' row
tap 'save a new spot', then follow the map

treatment.payoff: the same man walks straight to his crossover, it blinks hello, the new bag whole at his feet
treatment.signature: the paper bag ripping at the Lilo market stalls, oranges rolling across the lot

post.description: შაბათობით ლილოზე ადგილს ძლივს პოულობ, გამოსვლისას კი ყველა რიგი ერთმანეთს ჰგავს. შენ როგორ იმახსოვრებ ხოლმე, სად გააჩერე?

beats.say: ლილოზე მანქანების ზღვაა. | დედა რეკავს: | ტუტუცი, სადა ხარო?
